title: Mochizuki Honami — With All Our Supporters〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So are we.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Guys, hurry♪
I can't wait any longer!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Here's to an amazing show!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It was a wonderful show.
You did a great job of truly resonating with the audience.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You also did amazing, Miku!
I got goosebumps just listening.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! My jaw was on the floor the whole time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me three! I couldn't believe that I got to be a part of it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As for me, I was able to connect with you girls and everyone who came to see you play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It was an incredible performance...
You were able to showcase all the best aspects of Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! And I'm looking forward to seeing what your future shows are gonna be like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise not to disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But for now...
Why don't we get our party started?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As our way of thanking all of you, the four of us baked cupcakes for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here they are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, you made so many...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We do have a pretty big group here.
I think we made enough for three apiece.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! Then, I'm gonna take the biggest, yummiest-looking ones♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, before you do!
There's something we need to tell you all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On the surface, there only appear to be plain or matcha-flavored ones, but some of them have different fillings in them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Fillings?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... It's not hard to bake simple cupcakes that are also delicious, but Saki suggested that we should “spice things up” somehow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! So, we're gonna have ourselves a takoyaki party but with cupcakes♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you're saying that these cupcakes may or may not contain a few surprises...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Correct!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We each picked two fillings to put into them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But there's no need to worry. We didn't pick anything spicy or difficult to stomach since we didn't want it to feel like some sort of punishment.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, Saki, I don't feel great about your choices.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? What's wrong with sweet soybean powder and cod roe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Soybean powder and cod roe?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd be surprised too, but there's a chance that it might be good, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They put that powder on bread and stuff. Plus, cupcakes are made from flour, which is what they use for spaghetti. That goes great with cod roe, so it'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: T-Talk about a big stretch...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, this should spice things up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
So, shall we give them a try?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Dig in!
Dig in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's also try them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, these red bean paste cupcakes are delicious! Who came up with these?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I did.
My other ones have marmalade in them, and I think they turned out pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this one... It's full of nuts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mine has strawberry jam in it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those are both mine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Kudos for the red bean paste, but all these other ones seem...normal...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You sound so disappointed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They are meant to be party treats.
Also, we knew that Miku and the others would be trying them, so it only seemed right to make them as good as we could.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but you gotta be more on the edge with stuff like this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, Hona, what did you decide to put in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I chose custard for one, and the other...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, this cupcake...
It's full of apples. This tastes just like an apple pie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A-As it so happens...
That's my other one...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Hona, these are supposed to be cupcakes! Why'd you turn yours into apple pies?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I couldn't think of anything else...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You could've done tuna salad or marshmallows or potato chips or a million other things!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Urgh... Outside of marshmallows, those all sound awful...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, has anyone tried my soybean powder and cod roe cupcakes yet?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
This one has cod roe in it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bingo!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How is it, Hona?!
Is it good?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The cod roe is a little dry from being baked... But I think it sort of goes well with the butter...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Hear that, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's just her being polite...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, that's it!
Hona, give some of what you have to these nonbelievers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
